title: Grab and spin
goal: Move and turn shapes on the picture with your own hands.

steps.say: Point at group. It moves, turns, or grows everything inside.
Point at rotate. How far to turn the shapes, in degrees.
Drag the box on the picture to move it. The numbers follow your hand.
Drag the round handle to spin the box. Watch rotate change as you turn.
Or type the angle straight in: change 0 to 30.
The box should sit turned a little, like the target.
